fallback_field_source.release_handling: Internal terminology witness only. Exclude the PDF, extracted text, and rendered review pages from public release payloads; publish only bibliographic identity, URLs, observations, and cryptographic hashes.
fallback_field_source.count_method: Case-insensitive Unicode-letter-bounded phrase matches in the extracted text.
fallback_field_source.quality_caveat: This is a representative field-usage witness, not a linguistic authority. It contains inconsistent terminology and typographical defects, so its forms were evaluated against mathematical meaning and edition consistency rather than copied mechanically.

decisions.reason: Peluang is the natural default for an event or result; probabilitas remains an accepted variant and is retained only in an established compound.
Both forms are established in Indonesian university usage. Retaining the already controlled compound avoids an unnecessary cross-boundary churn while event-level probability remains peluang.
Directly supported by the fallback probability text and semantically transparent.
Harmonizes the head noun with event-level peluang and matches field usage.
Bersama cleanly denotes simultaneous/intersection probability; reserving gabungan for set union avoids ambiguity. Indonesian mathematical sources attest both forms.
Uses the edition's scalar term peluang bersama while recording the fallback text's established gabungan form as a variant.
Both are established; the existing edition term remains clear and symmetric.
Directly attested and aligned with the localized figures.
Natural Indonesian and exactly aligned with the visible localized-figure labels.
Directly attested by the fallback text.
The official IPB course title uses Statistika Bayes; Bayesian remains an established adjectival variant.
